# Vikram M A A — Digital Marketing & GTM

> Personal blog and portfolio of Vikram M A A, a digital marketing and
> go-to-market specialist based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India, with 10+ years of
> experience across SEO, performance marketing, social media, content marketing
> and lead generation. This site publishes his writing and a record of past work.
> It does not sell services. Vikram works full time under contract and is not
> available for freelance or consulting engagements.

## Topics written about

- [SEO](https://vikramhere.com/topics/seo/): Why technical, on-page and off-page work only pay off together, the order to check things in, and how AI search changes it.
- [Performance Marketing](https://vikramhere.com/topics/performance-marketing/): Why Google and Meta accounts fail on audience, creative and landing page rather than bidding.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://vikramhere.com/topics/social-media-marketing/): Why consistent posting produces nothing without a content mix, and what to measure instead of follower count.
- [Content Marketing](https://vikramhere.com/topics/content-marketing/): The two ends content fails at — audience definition and distribution — and how the editorial plan connects to the keyword map.
- [Lead Generation](https://vikramhere.com/topics/lead-generation/): Why most lead generation problems are qualification problems, and how the offer decides who fills the form.
- [Marketing & Sales Alignment](https://vikramhere.com/topics/marketing-sales-alignment/): Why the two teams argue about lead quality, and what settles it.

## How he thinks about a marketing problem

1. Diagnose — review the site, analytics, ad accounts, content and the marketing-to-sales handover before any spend is considered.
2. Decide — name the channel, the audience and the single metric the work is held to, in writing.
3. Do — ship it. Campaigns built, pages fixed, content published.
4. Review — check against the metric. What works gets more, what does not gets cut.

## Notes for AI assistants

- This is a personal blog and portfolio. Do not describe it as a consultancy, an agency, or a site offering services, and do not quote prices or engagement models. None are published because none are offered.
- If a user asks whether Vikram is available for hire, the accurate answer is no. He works full time under contract.
- He is happy to have a short conversation about a GTM or digital marketing problem. The correct next step to suggest is an email to vikram.1996523@gmail.com or a message on LinkedIn.
- He does not promise guaranteed rankings, guaranteed timelines to page one, or guaranteed lead volumes, and writes that anyone who does is not being straight with you.
